title: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say
english: A 24-year-old Polish man suspected of killing nine people, including his own family members and victims in Krakow’s city center, has died in the hospital. The attacker, who reportedly held far-right extremist views, was shot by police shortly after the assault began. Authorities confirmed that the victims in the city square included both Polish citizens and foreign nationals.

title: Inside the French drug gangs recruiting children to kill
english: Drug gangs in Marseille, France, are increasingly exploiting vulnerable teenagers by recruiting them for illegal activities under the guise of work. These young people often face brutal violence, sexual abuse, and blackmail if they fail to meet gang demands. This situation highlights a dangerous cycle of exploitation where gangs use fear and social media to trap youth in organized crime.

title: Trump says he was 'kidding' about Dana White press secretary offer
english: President Donald Trump has clarified that his recent offer for UFC CEO Dana White to become the White House press secretary was merely a joke. Although Trump had publicly claimed on social media that he invited White to the role, he later told reporters that the comment was not meant to be taken seriously. White, who leads multiple business ventures, is still scheduled to meet with the president, though not to discuss taking the government position.

title: At least 34 dead after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal
english: A wooden boat carrying migrants toward Spain's Canary Islands capsized off the coast of Senegal, resulting in at least 34 deaths. While one survivor has been rescued, search efforts are ongoing to determine if others remain missing. In response, Senegal's President has promised to crack down on human trafficking networks and encouraged citizens to avoid these perilous sea journeys.

Preezidaantiin Senegaal balaa kanaan gaddi itti dhaga'ame ibsuun, namoota seeraan alaa baqattoota deddeebisan irratti tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatan fi lammiileen isaanii imala balaa qabu kana irraa akka of qusatan dhaamaniiru.

title: Pope delivers veiled rebuke of Milei's austerity measures
english: Pope Leo XIV visited Argentina and voiced concerns regarding President Javier Milei's strict austerity policies. The Pope emphasized that economic systems should prioritize the welfare of vulnerable citizens, specifically highlighting the impact of spending cuts on those with disabilities. Additionally, the pontiff encouraged political leaders to practice more respectful communication and to manage their authority with greater caution.

title: At least one person killed as Russia and Ukraine trade strikes overnight
english: A recent exchange of overnight drone and missile attacks between Russia and Ukraine resulted in at least one civilian death and significant damage to a major Russian oil refinery. In response to ongoing Russian strikes on power grids, Ukraine is establishing a new emergency funding agreement with the European Union to repair essential energy infrastructure. Meanwhile, Russia continues to target Ukrainian utility systems and claims to have intercepted over a hundred drones while hitting a ship it accuses of transporting weapons.

title: Iran’s authorities harden domestic security controls amid US strike threats
english: In response to ongoing tensions and potential military threats from the United States, Iranian authorities have significantly tightened domestic security. The government is strictly enforcing public conduct rules and threatening severe penalties against any form of dissent or protests. Furthermore, officials are actively mobilizing loyalist supporters while using harsh judicial measures, including executions, to suppress internal opposition they label as foreign-backed terrorism.

title: The DNA that Unmasked a Killer | True Crime Reports
english: For over two decades, the murder of Leslie Preer remained an unsolved cold case despite early suspicions toward her husband. Recently, advanced genetic testing allowed investigators to identify a different person as the prime suspect, who was living very far from the crime scene. Police were then able to successfully lure and capture the individual, finally bringing resolution to the long-standing mystery.

title: Qatar PM to meet Trump: What’s the latest on US-Iran negotiations?
english: Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani is traveling to Washington to meet with President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance regarding the ongoing conflict with Iran. Qatar is currently acting as a mediator as the US reviews a new proposal from Tehran aimed at resolving nuclear program disputes and ceasefire terms. While Iran has threatened severe retaliation if US military strikes resume, both sides are engaged in high-level discussions to manage these tensions.
amharic: የኳታር ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ መሐመድ ቢን አብዱልራህማን ቢን ጃሲም አል ታኒ ከአሜሪካ ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ እና ምክትል ፕሬዚዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ጋር ለመወያየት ወደ ዋሽንግተን እያቀኑ ነው። ኳታር በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል እንደ አደራዳሪነት እየሰራች ሲሆን፣ ዋሽንግተንም ከቴህራን የቀረበውን አዲስ የኑክሌር ፕሮግራም እና የተኩስ አቁም የሰላም ዕቅድ እየመረመረች ነው። ምንም እንኳን ኢራን የአሜሪካ ጥቃት እንደገና ከተጀመረ ጠንካራ አጸፋ እንደምትወስድ ብታስጠነቅቅም፣ ውጥረቱን ለመቀነስ ከፍተኛ የዲፕሎማሲ ንግግሮች እየተካሄዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Qatar Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani dhimma waldhabdee Iran waliin jiru irratti mari'achuuf gara Washington imaluuf qophaa'aniiru. Qatar giddu-galeessummaa kan taate yoo ta'u, gama tokkoon mootummaan Ameerikaa dhiyeessa haarawaa Iran irraa dhufe kan sagantaa niwukilaraa fi dhaabbii waraanaa irratti xiyyeeffatu qorachaa jira. Iran yoo weerarri Ameerikaa itti fufe tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhattu akeekkachiisteeyyuu, gama lamaaniin rakkoo kana furuuf mariin dippiloomaasii cimaan adeemsifamaa jira.

title: Trump says his immigration policy ‘too tough’ for voters
english: President Donald Trump acknowledged that his aggressive deportation policies likely hurt the Republican Party in the recent midterm elections. While admitting his approach may have been overly harsh, he expressed a willingness to negotiate a more moderate immigration deal with the newly elected Democratic Congress. Despite these comments, his decision to appoint Stephen Miller, a key architect of his hardline policies, as his new chief of staff has sparked skepticism about whether a real policy shift will occur.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጠንካራ የስደት መቆጣጠሪያ ፖሊሲያቸው በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የመካከለኛው ዘመን ምርጫ ለሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ሽንፈት ምክንያት እንደሆነ አምነዋል። የወሰዱት እርምጃ ከመጠን በላይ ጥብቅ እንደነበረ ቢገልጹም፣ በአዲሱ የዲሞክራቶች ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው ኮንግረስ አማካኝነት ይበልጥ መካከለኛ የሆነ የስደት ስምምነት ለመፍጠር ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው ተናግረዋል። ሆኖም፣ ጥብቅ የፖሊሲ አቀንቃኙን እስጢፋኖስ ሚለርን የኋይት ሀውስ ዋና አዛዥ አድርገው መሾማቸው፣ በእርግጥ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ ይመጣ ይሆን የሚል ጥርጣሬ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Tiraamp imaayigreeshinii irratti tarkaanfiin inni cimaan fudhate filannoo gidduu waggaa darbe keessatti paartii Ripabliikaanirratti dhiibbaa geessiseera jedhanii amanan. Ilaalchi isaanii kun hamma tokko cimaa akka ture kan dubbatan yoo ta'u, kongeerasii harka Diimookraatonni jiru waliin ta'uun imaayigreeshinii irratti waliigaltee madaalawaa ta'e uumuuf fedhii qabaachuu ibsaniiru. Ta'us, namicha imaayigreeshinii irratti imaammata cimaa baasaa ture Stiiven Miilar jedhaman gara aangootti fiduun isaanii, jijjiiramni imaammataa dhugaan ni dhufa jedhee shakkiin akka uumamu godheera.

title: Iran defends two-day proposal for peace talks after US rejects conditions
english: Iran has defended its proposal to resume peace talks within two days, arguing that its demands for the removal of US sanctions and a naval blockade are necessary preconditions. While US officials have dismissed these requirements as unacceptable, Iran maintains that stopping the war and easing restrictions are logical steps toward diplomacy. Additionally, Iran criticized recent American efforts to pressure Iraq into closing borders, labeling such military initiatives as political distractions.
amharic: ኢራን የሰላም ንግግሮችን በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ ለመጀመር ያቀረበችውን ሃሳብ በመከላከል፣ የአሜሪካ ማዕቀቦች እና የባህር ላይ እገዳዎች መነሳት አለባቸው የሚለውን ቅድመ ሁኔታ እንደ አስፈላጊ እርምጃ ገልጻለች። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት እነዚህን ጥያቄዎች ውድቅ ቢያደርጉም፣ ኢራን ጦርነቱን ማቆም ለዲፕሎማሲው መፍትሄ ወሳኝ መሆኑን ትከራከራለች። በተጨማሪም ኢራን አሜሪካ በኢራቅ ላይ ድንበር እንዲዘጋ የምታደርገውን ጫና በመቃወም፣ ይህም የፖለቲካ ትኩረትን ለመቀየር የሚደረግ ሙከራ መሆኑን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Iraan marii nagaa guyyoota lama keessatti jalqabuuf yaada dhiyeessiteetti, kunis tarkanfii barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsiteetti. Iraan mariin kun akka jalqabuuf akkaataa sanadaa fi daangaa galaana irraa ka'uu qaba jettee gaafatteetti, haa ta'u malee mootummaan Ameerikaa gaaffii kana fudhatama kan hin qabne jedhee komateera. Dabalataanis, Iraan Ameerikaan Iraaq daangaa ishee akka cufu dhiibbaa gochuun ishee jeeqama siyaasaa uumuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu isaa ibsiteetti.

title: Gaza: Five Palestinians killed as sand embankment collapses on displacement tents
english: In Deir al-Balah, Gaza, five people including three children and two women died when a sand embankment collapsed onto their tents during heavy storms. Rescue teams are continuing search efforts as many others remain injured following the incident. Authorities attribute the tragedy to the lack of proper shelter and infrastructure caused by the ongoing war and blockade.
amharic: በጋዛ ዲር አል-በላህ አካባቢ በደረሰ ከባድ የዝናብ እና የነፋስ አውሎ ነፋስ ምክንያት የአሸዋ ክምር በመውደቁ ሶስት ህጻናትን እና ሁለት ሴቶችን ጨምሮ አምስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በአደጋው የቆሰሉ ሌሎች ሰዎች በነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ታድገው ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ሲሆን፣ የፍለጋ ስራውም ቀጥሏል። የሰብአዊ መብት ድርጅቶች እና ባለስልጣናት ይህ አደጋ የደረሰው በጦርነቱ ምክንያት በተፈጠረው የቤት እጦት እና የሰብአዊ እርዳታ እጥረት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti iddoo Deir al-Balah jedhamutti rooba cimaa fi bubbee hordofee gaarreen cirrachaa dunkaana buqqaatonni keessa jiraatan irratti kufuun ijoollee sadii fi dubartoota lama dabalatee namoonni shan lubbuun darbaniiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa namoota miidhaman baasuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiran yoo ta'u, rakkoon kun kan dhufe waraanaa fi daangaa cufamee jiruun walqabatee iddoon jireenyaa mijataa dhabamuu isaatiin akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Trump says he thinks he will meet with Xi, Putin, set to discuss ending war on Iran
english: President Donald Trump expects to hold meetings with the leaders of China and Russia during the upcoming APEC summit in Shenzhen. During these discussions, he intends to address various global topics, including the goal of nuclear disarmament. Furthermore, the President highlighted his administration's ongoing efforts to conclude the conflict in Iran through economic pressure.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርቡ በሼንዘን በሚካሄደው የኤፒክ (APEC) ጉባኤ ላይ ከቻይና እና ከሩሲያ መሪዎች ጋር ለመገናኘት እንደሚጠብቁ ገልጸዋል። በእነዚህ ውይይቶች ወቅት ስለ የኑክሌር መርሃ ግብሮች እና ሌሎች ዓለም አቀፍ ጉዳዮች ላይ ለመነጋገር አቅደዋል። በተጨማሪም ፕሬዝዳንቱ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦችን በመጠቀም በኢራን እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ለማቆም ጥረት እያደረጉ መሆናቸውን ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantichi Donald Traamp torban dhufu magaalaa Sheenzeenitti walga'ii APEC irratti geggeeffamu irratti hogganoota Chaayinaa fi Raashiyaa waliin wal arguuf akka karoorfatan ibsaniiru. Marii isaanii kanaanis dhimmoota addunyaa fi dhimma diinagdee niwukileerii irratti kan mari'atan ta'a. Dabalataanis, pirezidaantichi dhiibbaa diinagdee fayyadamuun waraana Iraan keessatti adeemaa jiru xumursiisuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiran ibsaniiru.

title: China says it is willing to promote fresh progress in bilateral relations with Iran
english: China's Middle East envoy, Zhai Jun, recently visited Iran to discuss strengthening ties between the two nations. During his meetings, he emphasized that the current regional conflicts cannot be solved through military means. Both sides expressed a desire to advance their bilateral relationship further.
amharic: የቻይና የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ልዩ መልዕክተኛ ዣይ ጁን በኢራን ያደረጉት ጉብኝት በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ቀውስ በወታደራዊ ኃይል ሊፈታ እንደማይችል የገለጹት መልዕክተኛው፣ የሁለቱን ወገኖች የትብብር ግንኙነት ለማሳደግ ያላቸውን ፍላጎት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ergamoonni Chaayinaa kan gidduu galeessa bahaa Zhaay Juun biyya Iraan daawwataniiru. Ergamoonni kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru cimsuuf mari'ataniiru. Rakkoon gidduu galeessa bahaa humna waraanaan furamuu akka hin dandeenye ibsuun, hariiroo isaan cimsuuf fedhii qaban beeksisaniiru.

title: Trump set to meet Qatar’s prime minister at the White House
english: President Donald Trump is scheduled to host a private meeting with the Prime Minister of Qatar, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, at the White House this Monday. During his visit, the Qatari leader is also expected to hold separate discussions with Vice President JD Vance. These high-level meetings highlight ongoing diplomatic engagements between the United States and Qatar.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሰኞ ዕለት በኋይት ሀውስ የኳታሩን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ መሐመድ ቢን አብዱልረህማን አል ታኒን በግል እንደሚያነጋግሩ ይጠበቃል። በዚሁ ጉብኝት ወቅት የኳታሩ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ከምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ጋር እንደሚመክሩም ታውቋል። እነዚህ ከፍተኛ የልዑካን ውይይቶች በአሜሪካ እና በኳታር መካከል ያለውን የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት የሚያሳዩ ናቸው።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp Dilbata kana Mana Qulqulluu (White House) keessatti Ministira Muummee Qaataar Sheek Mohaammad biin Abdurraahmaan Al-Taanii waliin walarganii mari'achuuf karoorfataniiru. Daawwannaa kana keessatti, hogganaan Qaataar kun Itti Aanaa Pirezidaantii Jeey Dii Vaans waliinis marii addaa akka godhan eegama. Mariin sadarkaa olaanaa kun hariiroo diippiloomaasii Ameerikaafi Qaataar gidduu jiru kan ibsuudha.

title: Aramco Tower hit in heart of Saudi capital as Houthis launch fresh strikes
english: The Houthi rebel group launched an aerial attack on a prominent Aramco building in the center of Riyadh, causing structural damage. While Saudi officials claimed the impact was minimal with no casualties, video evidence indicates significant destruction to the tower. These strikes occur amidst escalating regional tensions, serving as retaliation for recent Saudi-led coalition actions in Yemen.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ዋና ከተማ ሪያድ በሚገኘው የአራምኮ ሕንፃ ላይ የአየር ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። የሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱ መጠነኛ ጉዳት ብቻ እንዳደረሰ እና የሰው ህይወት እንዳልጠፋ ቢገልጹም፣ የተለቀቁ ምስሎች በህንፃው ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳት ከባድነት ያሳያሉ። ይህ ጥቃት በየመን እየተካሄደ ካለው ግጭት ጋር ተያይዞ በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው ውጥረት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: gareen qabsaa'ota Huutii jedhamu magaalaa guddoo Saudii Arabiyaa, Riyaaditti gamoo Aramco irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwateera. Mootummaan Saudii miidhaan gahuu isaa fi lubbuun namaa darbuu isaa haalus, vidiyoon dhimmicha irratti bahe miidhaan gamoo sana irra gahuu isaa agarsiisa. Haleellaan kun waraana Yaman keessatti geggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee rakkoon gama lameenii gidduu jiru hammaachuu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Drone attack suspends production at Iraq’s Khor Mor gasfield
english: A drone strike on the Khor Mor gas field in Iraq’s semi-autonomous Kurdish region has ignited a fire and forced a halt to production. The attack significantly disrupted the regional power grid, leaving over 70 percent of the area without electricity. Authorities are currently investigating the incident, while emergency measures are being taken to maintain power for essential services like hospitals.
amharic: በኢራቅ የኩርድ ክልል በሚገኘው የኮር ሞር የጋዝ ማምረቻ ማዕከል ላይ በደረሰ የድሮን ጥቃት የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቶ የምርት ሂደቱ ተቋርጧል። ጥቃቱ የክልሉን የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦት በእጅጉ በመጉዳቱ ከ70 በመቶ በላይ የሚሆነው አካባቢ ያለ መብራት ቀርቷል። ባለሥልጣናት የጥቃቱን መንስኤ ለማጣራት ምርመራ የጀመሩ ሲሆን፣ እንደ ሆስፒታሎች ላሉ አስፈላጊ አገልግሎቶች መብራት እንዲኖር አማራጭ እርምጃዎች እየተወሰዱ ነው።
oromo: Irak keessatti bakka gaazii ‘Khor Mor’ jedhamutti boombii tiraaniin (drone) ergame miidhaa geessiseen ibidni ka’ee hojiin dhaabbateera. Haleellaan kun humna ibsaa naannichaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee, harki 70 ol ta’u ibsaa malee hafeera. Aangeyyotni haleellaa kana qorachaa jiru, yeroo ammaa kana garuu tajaajila barbaachisaa kanneen akka hospitaalotaaf ibsaan akka hin kutamne tattaaffiin taasifamaa jira.

title: India’s night lights up for Diwali
english: India is currently celebrating Diwali, which is widely known as the annual festival of lights. During this major Hindu occasion, people across the country engage in vibrant festivities including religious prayers and spectacular fireworks displays. The celebration serves as a significant cultural highlight that illuminates the nation.
amharic: ህንድ በአሁኑ ወቅት የብርሃን በዓል በመባል የሚታወቀውን ዲዋሊን እያከበረች ነው። በዚሁ ታላቅ የሂንዱ እምነት ተከታዮች በዓል ላይ መላው የሀገሪቱ ህዝብ በጸሎት፣ በደማቅ መብራቶች እና በአምሮ የርችት ድግሶች ይሳተፋሉ። ይህ በዓል ሀገሪቱን በብርሃን የሚያደምቅ ትልቅ ባህላዊ ክንውን ነው።
oromo: Indiyaan yeroo ammaa kana ayyaana Diwaalii ykn ayyaana ibsaa jedhamuun beekamu kabajaa jirti. Ayyaana guddaa amantii Hinduu kana irratti, namoonni guutummaa biyyattii keessa jiran kadhataa, ibsaa fi qabsiisaa babbadaa ta'een gammachuu isaanii ibsatu. Ayyaanichi biyyattii guutuu kan ifsiisu fi kabaja guddaa kan qabuudha.

title: Jeffries backs Hegseth impeachment as Democrats vow probes of Trump allies
english: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries has officially endorsed the impeachment of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of misusing power and mishandling the conflict in Iran. Following a decisive Democratic victory in the midterm elections, party leaders intend to launch aggressive investigations into the Trump administration. Jeffries promised that the new Democratic majority will prioritize addressing government corruption and economic concerns during their first 100 days in power.
amharic: የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አናሳ መሪ ሃኪም ጄፍሪስ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በስልጣን অপአላግባብ መጠቀም እና ኢራን ውስጥ በተፈጠረው ግጭት ላይ ባደረጉት የተሳሳተ አያያዝ ምክንያት ከስልጣን እንዲነሱ ድጋፋቸውን ሰጥተዋል። በምርጫው ያገኙትን ድል ተከትሎ ዲሞክራቶች በትራምፕ አስተዳደር ላይ ጠንካራ ምርመራዎችን ለመጀመር አቅደዋል። ጄፍሪስ አዲሱ የዲሞክራቶች የበላይነት በመንግስት ውስጥ ያለውን ሙስና እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ችግሮችን ለመቅረፍ በመጀመሪያዎቹ መቶ ቀናት ውስጥ በንቃት እንደሚሰሩ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan garee xiqqaa mana maree bakka bu'oota uummataa Hakeem Jeffries, ministeera ittisa biyyaa Pete Hegseth aangoosaa ganda fayyadamuufi waraana Iraan irratti tarkaanfii dogoggoraa fudhachuu isaatiin himatamee akka aangoo irraa bu'u deggeraniiru. Injifannoo filannoo gidduu galeessaarratti argataniin booda, paartiin Demokraata mootummaa Donald Trump irratti qorannoo cimaa gaggeessuuf karoorfateera. Jeffries akka ibsetti, harka caaluu Demokraatonni argatan kanaan mootummaa keessatti malaammaltummaa fi rakkoolee dinagdee furuuf guyyoota dhibba jalqabaatti xiyyeeffannoo kennuuf waadaa galaniiru.

title: Iran war live: Trump says ‘Iron Gate’ in effect; drone hits Iraq gasfield
english: President Trump has announced that a new US land blockade on Iran is now active as tensions remain high. He plans to meet with the leaders of China and Russia to discuss potential denuclearization and the ongoing conflict. Meanwhile, a drone strike in Iraqi Kurdistan has caused an explosion at a gas field, leading to a temporary halt in production.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ አዲሱ የአሜሪካ የምድር ላይ እገዳ ተግባራዊ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ከቻይና እና ከሩሲያ መሪዎች ጋር በኑክሌር ትጥቅ ማስፈታት እና አሁን ባለው ግጭት ዙሪያ ለመነጋገር እቅድ አላቸው። በሌላ በኩል በኢራቅ ኩርዲስታን በሚገኝ የጋዝ ማውጫ ቦታ ላይ በድሮን ጥቃት በመድረሱ የምርት ስራው ለጊዜው ተቋርጧል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Tiraamp dhiibbaan gama lafaa Ameerikaan Iraan irratti kaa’uuf karoorfatte hojiirra ooluusaa ibsaniiru. Dhimma nukleerii fi walitti bu’iinsa jiru irratti mari’achuuf gaggeessitoota Chaayinaa fi Raashiyaa waliin wal arguuf qophaa’aa jiru. Gamtaan biroo, biyya Iraaq naannoo Kurdiistaanitti bakka gaazii baasu tokko irratti miidhaan dorooneen geessifame hojii omishaa yeroof akka dhaabbatu godheera.

title: Nvidia CEO’s affair sparks Chinese espionage probe
english: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has acknowledged a personal relationship with a woman who is currently under investigation for potential espionage on behalf of China. While the company has initiated its own internal probe into the matter, they maintain that no confidential corporate data was compromised. Nvidia continues to monitor the situation to ensure their security remains intact.
amharic: የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ ከቻይና ጋር በመተባበር ሰላይ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ ከተባሉ ሴት ጋር የነበራቸውን ግንኙነት አምነዋል። ኩባንያው ጉዳዩን በውስጥ ምርመራ እያጣራ ቢሆንም፣ እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ሚስጥራዊ የኩባንያ መረጃ መውጣቱን የሚያሳይ ማስረጃ እንደሌለ አስታውቋል። የድርጅቱ ደህንነት አለመደፍረሱን ለማረጋገጥ ኩባንያው ሁኔታውን በቅርበት እየተከታተለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata Nvidia Jensen Huang, dubartii shakkii basaasummaa Chaayinaatiin qabamtee jirtu tokko waliin hariiroo akka qabu beeksiseera. Dhaabbatichi dhimma kana irratti qorannoo keessoo kan jalqabe yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti odeeffannoon icitii kamiyyuu akka hin baane mirkaneesseera. Nvidia nageenyummaan dhaabbatichaa kan hin tuqamne ta'uu isaa mirkaneeffachuuf haala jiru hordofaa jira.

title: Lopez double fires Barcelona to win at Atletico Madrid
english: Fermin Lopez scored two goals to help Barcelona defeat Atletico Madrid 2-1 after trailing early in the match. This important victory puts Barcelona three points ahead of Real Madrid at the top of the La Liga standings. The team successfully overcame a difficult start to maintain their winning streak against Atletico away from home.
amharic: ፈርሚን ሎፔዝ ሁለት ግቦችን በማስቆጠር ባርሴሎና በአትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ ላይ 2 ለ 1 እንዲያሸንፍ አስችሎታል። ይህ ወሳኝ ድል ባርሴሎናን ከሪያል ማድሪድ በሦስት ነጥብ ብልጫ የላሊጋው አናት ላይ አስቀምጦታል። ባርሴሎናም በመጀመሪያ ተቆጥሮበት የነበረውን ጎል በመቀልበስ በአትሌቲኮ ሜዳ ላይ ድሉን ተቀዳጅቷል።
oromo: Fermin Lopez goolii lama lakkoofsiisuun Barcelona tapha Atletico Madrid irratti 2-1 akka injifattu gargaareera. Injifannoon kun Barcelona sadarkaa La Ligaa irratti Real Madrid irraa qabxii sadiin akka dursitu taasiseera. Barcelona jalqaba goolii itti lakkoofsisullee, haala rakkisaa keessaa bahuun injifannoo kana galmeeffachuu danda'eera.

title: President Milei welcomes Pope Leo during historic visit to Argentina
english: Pope Leo XIV has arrived in Argentina for a historic visit, marking the first time a pontiff has traveled to the country in nearly forty years. President Javier Milei greeted the Pope at the airport despite ongoing disagreements between the government and the Church regarding recent economic austerity policies. The visit takes place as the Catholic Church faces a decline in membership across the region and political friction over the country's social welfare budget cuts.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ ዐሥራ አራተኛ ለአርጀንቲና ታሪካዊ ጉብኝት አድርገዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ለአርጀንቲና ያደረጉት የመጀመሪያው ጉብኝት በቅርብ አርባ ዓመታት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ነው። ፕሬዚዳንት ጃቪየር ሚሌይ መንግስታቸው የኢኮኖሚ ቁጠባ እርምጃዎችን በመውሰዱ ከቤተክርስቲያኑ ጋር አለመግባባት ቢኖርም ሊቀ ጳጳሳቱን አቀባበል አድርገውላቸዋል።
oromo: Paaphaasii Leo 14ffaan biyya Arjantiinaatti daawwannaa seena qabeessa ta'e kan geggeessan yoo ta'u, kunis waggoota 40 keessatti kan jalqabaati. Pirezidaanti Jaaviyar Miileyi, mootummaan isaanii seera diinagdee cimaa hojiirra oolchuun walqabatee walitti bu'iinsi waldaa kiristaanaa wajjin jiraatus, paaphaasicha buufata xiyyaaraatti simataniiru. Daawwannaan kunis waldaan kiristaanaa biyyattii keessatti guddina xiqqaa argachaa fi rakkoo siyaasaa keessa jirutti taasifameera.

title: US chipmaker Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair
english: Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following his admission of an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese intelligence operative. Although the board currently trusts Huang’s leadership and has no evidence that company secrets or national security were breached, they are conducting the inquiry to ensure transparency. This situation follows allegations that the woman used her connection to Huang to gather sensitive information, prompting significant concern among US lawmakers.
amharic: የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁአንግ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር ግንኙነት እንደነበራቸው በማመናቸው ኩባንያው ገለልተኛ ምርመራ ጀምሯል። የኩባንያው ቦርድ በአሁኑ ወቅት በዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚው ላይ እምነት እንዳለው ቢገልጽም፣ የድርጅቱ ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎች ወይም የሀገር ደህንነት መጣሱን ለማጣራት ምርመራው አስፈላጊ ሆኗል። ይህ ክስተት የተከሰተው ተጠርጣሪዋ ሴት ስለ ኤንቪዲያ ቴክኖሎጂ መረጃ ለመሰብሰብ ሞክራለች በሚል በተነሳው ውዝግብ ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ በአሜሪካ የህግ አውጪዎች ዘንድ ትልቅ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni dhaabbata Nvidia, hoji gaggeessaa isaanii Jensen Huang dubartii akka ispeeshii Chaayinaatti shakkamtu tokko waliin hariiroo qabaachuu isaanii erga mirkaneeffatanii booda qorannoo walabaa jalqabaniiru. Yaa’iin dhaabbatichaa ammayyuu hogganaa isaanii irratti amantaa qabaachuu fi iccitiin dhaabbatichaa ykn nageenyi biyyaa miidhamuu isaa hanga ammaa ragaan akka hin jirre ibseera. Qorannoon kun kan godhame dubartittiin kun odeeffannoo teeknoolojii Nvidia walitti qabuuf hariiroo kana fayyadamteetti shakkii jedhuufi kanneen biroo ifa godhuufi.

title: Why Trump wants UFC chief Dana White as his new White House press secretary
english: President Donald Trump has offered UFC CEO Dana White the position of White House press secretary following recent political setbacks for his party. The two men, who share a long-standing personal and business relationship, are scheduled to meet to discuss the potential appointment. While White has expressed interest by posting about the role, he also noted that his current professional commitments might pose a challenge to taking the job.

title: Deadly sand cliff collapses on displaced families in Gaza
english: A tragic incident occurred in Gaza when a sand cliff collapsed onto tents where displaced families were seeking shelter. At least five individuals, including several children, lost their lives in the disaster. This event highlights the extreme dangers faced by civilians who have been forced to relocate due to the ongoing conflict.

Taateen kun namoota walitti buiinsa kanaan sababii godhatanii iddoo tokko irraa gara kaaniitti godaanan irratti balaan hangam ulfaataa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Surgeon having lunch near Krakow shooting undoubtedly saved officer's life, colleague says
english: Two surgeons eating lunch in Krakow rushed to provide emergency medical aid when a gunman opened fire near the city center, killing six people and injuring fifteen. One of the doctors is credited with saving a police officer's life by performing critical wound care while waiting for an ambulance. Authorities are investigating the mass shooting, which involved a 24-year-old suspect motivated by far-right extremist views.

oromo: Magala Krakaw keessatti nama meeshaa waraanaa hidhateen dhukaasa banameen lubbuun namoota jahaa darbee kanneen biroo kudha shaniin madaa'anii jiru. Yeroo balaan kun gahuu, ogeeyyonni baqaqsanii hodhuu lama bakka sana nyaata nyaachaa turan battalatti ariifatanii madaa'ota gargaaruun lubbuu qondaala poolisii tokkoo oolchaniiru. Balaa kana kan raawwate dargaggeessa waggaa 24 akka ta'eefi gochi kun yaada fira qolqolii (far-right) irratti kan hundaa'e tahuun qorannoon eegalameera.

title: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt
english: A serious train collision near Giza, Egypt, has resulted in at least seven deaths and over 100 injuries. The accident occurred when a moving train crashed into the back of a stationary train, causing several carriages to derail and overturn. Egyptian authorities have launched an official investigation into the cause of the disaster, while local hospitals remain on high alert to treat the many victims.

Mootummaan Masrii balaa kana qorachuuf hojiirra jiraachuu beeksiseera; hospitaalonni naannichas namoota miidhaman wal'aanuuf of eeggannoo cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Homes and temples glow across India to mark Diwali
english: Millions of people across India are celebrating Diwali, the festival of lights, which commemorates the victory of good over evil through prayer, decorations, and family gatherings. However, this year's festivities are overshadowed by severe air pollution, particularly in Delhi, where smog levels have reached a ten-year high. To address environmental concerns, the Supreme Court has limited fireworks to specific eco-friendly versions, though their effectiveness remains a topic of debate.

title: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests
english: Iranian authorities have executed three men convicted of engaging in armed violence during anti-government protests held earlier this year in the city of Karaj. The men were accused of using weapons, damaging public infrastructure, and collaborating with foreign entities to incite unrest. These executions follow a series of similar lethal sentences carried out by the state in response to widespread demonstrations.

title: Al Jazeera tries Baseball5 at Youth Olympics
english: Al Jazeera journalist Nic Haque visited the 2026 Youth Olympics in Senegal to experience new sports firsthand. He teamed up with French athletes to learn the basics of Baseball5, a fast-paced variation of traditional baseball. This event is historically significant as it marks the first time an Olympic competition has taken place on the African continent.

title: Man United earn 4-4 draw against Aston Villa but remain in relegation zone
english: Manchester United managed a dramatic 4-4 draw against Aston Villa after scoring two late goals during stoppage time. Despite this comeback, the team remains in the relegation zone, sitting in 18th place after a difficult start to the season. This result provides temporary relief for manager Michael Carrick, whose position has been under significant pressure following a series of poor performances.

title: After the midterms, where does the Republican Party stand?
english: In the recent US midterm elections, the Democratic Party achieved a significant victory by gaining control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate. Voters expressed their dissatisfaction with the current national direction, largely driven by economic struggles like rising fuel and food prices resulting from the war with Iran. This shift in power means Democrats now hold the authority to launch investigations into the Trump administration and will significantly influence legislative priorities for the next two years.

title: Carlos Alcaraz beats Ben Shelton to win Paris Masters tennis title
english: Carlos Alcaraz secured his first Paris Masters title by defeating Ben Shelton in straight sets. This victory serves as a comeback for the Spaniard, who had previously lost to Shelton at the US Open earlier this year. With this win, Alcaraz adds a ninth 1000-level title to his career and heads into the upcoming ATP Finals in strong form.

title: Eisenkot open to Netanyahu joining Israel’s next government
english: Gadi Eisenkot has been officially tasked with forming Israel's next government and is open to including his political rival, Benjamin Netanyahu, in a potential coalition. Despite leading the opposition, Eisenkot needs to bridge the gap between his alliance and other parties to secure a parliamentary majority. President Isaac Herzog emphasized the urgent need for a stable government to navigate the changing political landscape in the United States.

title: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
english: New Zealanders recently held one of their closest elections ever amidst a national mood of widespread apathy, economic frustration, and disillusionment. The incoming government faces the difficult task of addressing deep-seated concerns regarding the cost of living, declining economic prospects, and a waning sense of national optimism.

title: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi missiles targeting Riyadh, Eastern province
english: Saudi Arabia’s air defense systems successfully intercepted several ballistic and cruise missiles launched by Houthi forces toward Riyadh and the Eastern province. These attacks occur amid escalating violence in Yemen, where government forces are attempting to reclaim territory from the rebels. Simultaneously, Houthi officials reported that a coalition airstrike near Sanaa resulted in the deaths of 33 civilians, including many women and children.

english: Severe rainfall has flooded tens of thousands of makeshift tents across Gaza, leaving many displaced families without adequate shelter. Local emergency services are struggling to provide aid due to a critical lack of equipment and the ongoing restrictions on humanitarian support. Authorities have issued an urgent plea to international organizations for immediate assistance to address the deepening crisis.

english: Following a significant defeat in the recent midterm elections, some Republican leaders are questioning the party's long-standing policy of unconditional support for Israel. This shift suggests that the traditional Republican consensus on foreign policy may be changing as the party evaluates its future political strategy.

title: There is reason to hope that the Democrats might deliver this time
english: Following the recent US midterm elections, voters have provided the Democratic Party with a renewed opportunity after rejecting Trumpism. The author notes that Democrats achieved success by focusing more on progressive economic populism and supporting working-class interests rather than traditional neoliberal policies. Success in future cycles now depends on whether the party can effectively deliver on these promises to avoid further voter backlash.
